subject: Re: MAP & compliance runbook — Palisade Financial (SOC2/SIG/DPA timelines)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@palisadefinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kick-off & compliance runbook - proposed milestones

Alyssa — thanks for the time earlier. Attaching an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft SIG/CAIQ answers doc to get the compliance lane moving. High-level proposal below; please flag anything that won't work for Palisade.

Proposed MAP milestones (aligned to Palisade procurement timelines):
- Week 1 (by 2028-07-22): Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary report, encryption & KMS details, and completed first-pass SIG answers (attached).
- Week 2 (by 2028-07-28): Legal teams exchange DPA redline; Palisade to provide required contractual deletions/residency clauses.
- Week 3 (by 2028-08-04): Evidence handoff & tech Q&A session (demos + log-sampling) to validate retention/segregation posture.
- Week 4 (by 2028-08-11): Final SIG acceptance and DPA sign-off target; decision to pilot/PO release.

Key compliance points we expect you'll want clarified now:
1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains annual SOC 2 Type II; we will provide a redacted report and a control mapping to Palisade's control set.
2) SIG/CAIQ: We'll complete the detailed answers and indicate where compensating controls exist. Marcus will own the technical evidence list.
3) DPA & retention: Default data retention for transient inference logs = 30 days; transaction records retention can be configurable up to 7 years per contract. We support per-customer retention TTL and can add retention/erasure endpoints.
4) Data residency: We can pin model serving to us-west or eu-central regions; for Palisade we recommend us-west.

Please see attached: Palisade_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners/ETA), SIG-CAIQ-draft-answers.docx, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf.

Next steps: if the milestone dates look okay, I'll circulate an updated MAP with named owners and a DocuSign link for the DPA when redlines are agreed.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-draft-answers.docx (docx, 220KB)

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@palisadefinance.com>

Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@palisadefinance.com>, procure@palisadefinance.com
Date: 2028-07-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off & compliance runbook - proposed milestones

Hi Kimberly — appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. A few quick notes from Palisade's side after a quick read-through: 
- Week 1 deliverables look good; we need the SOC2 redacted report and the control mapping by 7/22 to brief our InfoSec council on 7/25.
- For SIG: can you flag any "No" answers that are in the privacy/retention section? We need to see where manual compensating controls apply.
- DPA: our legal team will push for a 90-day breach notification clause and a limit on subprocessor locations. We'll circulate initial redlines by 7/27.
- Retention: 30 days for transient logs is acceptable; we need a vendor commitment for secure deletion and an API we can call for on-demand erasure. Also need to confirm whether embeddings derived from customer data are purged on request (they are considered customer content for us).

Action items for Redwood:
- Confirm embedding purge flow and timeframe (Marcus).
- Provide evidence of KMS/HSM usage and key rotation cadence (Neha).
- Confirm whether audit logs for admin actions are retained 12 months by default (Kimberly please confirm if this is configurable).

I'll loop in Tom (platform security) and procurement once we see the DPA redline.

Thanks,

Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Security | Palisade Financial
alyssa@palisadefinance.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@palisadefinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off & compliance runbook - proposed milestones

Alyssa — good questions. Quick responses inline plus owners and a proposed logistics call: 

- Embeddings purge: Marcus — can you confirm via reply but short answer: yes, embeddings derived from customer content are treated as customer data. We support a purge endpoint that will remove customer embeddings within 48 hours of request; complete cryptographic rekeying/rotation can be scheduled if requested.
- KMS/HSM & key rotation: Neha — can you attach the KMS evidence pack (key rotation cadence, HSM attestation) to the SIG answers? The pack will include our vendor attestations.
- Admin/audit logs: By default we retain admin audit logs for 12 months; longer retention windows are available as a premium observability add-on (configurable).

Logistics: propose 45-minute technical evidence walk-through on 2028-07-20 at 10:00am PT. Marcus/Neha and Alyssa/Tom + Palisade security SME. Please confirm.

I'll also update the MAP to assign Marcus to SIG evidence and Neha to SOC2/KMS materials; I'll share the updated MAP by EOD 7/16.

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: (to follow) updated_MAP_v1.xlsx (will be sent)

--- Forwarded message from Marcus Lin ---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@palisadefinance.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Embeddings purge & evidence

Alyssa / Kimberly — confirming the embedding purge flow: we support a customer-scoped purge endpoint (POST /v1/customers/{id}/purge) which queues deletion of derived artifacts and associated caches. Typical complete removal timeframe is 24–48 hours; we also remove KV-cached prefixes immediately at request. We will provide an internal runbook snippet and sample API call during the 7/20 walkthrough.

I'll prepare the SIG evidence bundle: sample config files, keystore descriptions, and a short demo of the purge flow (no customer data will be in the demo).

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@palisadefinance.com>

Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@palisadefinance.com>, procure@palisadefinance.com
Date: 2028-07-18T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off & compliance runbook - proposed milestones

Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and for lining up the walkthrough. Tom and I confirmed the 7/20 10:00am PT slot. A couple of small updates from procurement/security: 

- Procurement will still expect DPA redlines by 7/27 (they want a week to review before their 8/3 internal approval meeting).
- Our security council wants an explicit note in the MAP calling out "no-embedding retention by default" unless customer opts into longer retention. Can Redwood add that as a configurable flag in the MAP?
- For the SIG answers: any items where Redwood's posture is a compensating control instead of direct feature coverage, please highlight them as "Compensating Control" in the answers doc so our reviewers can triage faster.

If we get SOC2 + SIG evidence + DPA redline in the windows above, Palisade expects to make a pilot approval decision by 2028-08-11. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,

Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Security | Palisade Financial
